title: stream-dialect-row
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

schemaVersions.description: Versions of the stream's session header that the row accepts

providerFormat.description: The literal by which the stream names its provider format

telemetryOff.description: Variables and flags that switch the harness's telemetry off

sessionControl.description: Variables and flags that switch sessions off, name a session directory, and continue a session by id

extraRecords.description: Record types of this dialect beyond the common ones, each with the normalized kind it maps to, or `ignore`

usageNames.description: Names under which the dialect reports input, output, cache and reasoning tokens and cost

terminalDecides.description: Whether success is decided by the terminal record of the stream and not by the exit code

limits.description: The cap on the size of a line and on the rate of lines, where the dialect needs other values than the stream seam

endWords.description: The words at the end of an agent's stream that mean an error and those that mean success, where the dialect needs other words than the reader's
